description: Dr. Richard Briggs has a passion for service. He stands for improving education, creating jobs and keeping taxes low. Dr. Briggs promises to continue serving this district with honor and integrity. He believes we can do better for our community and the great state of Tennessee.

title: Richard Briggs, trauma surgeon, reflects on 20 years since the start of the Iraq War - Dr. Richard Briggs – Tennessee Senate
